svg.title: What runs where
svg.desc: Blocks: the owner's devices reach a remote-access container, then the firewall VM, then the c1 cluster. GitHub feeds the agent box and Argo CD. The agent box builds the dev cluster and c1. c1 runs Argo CD, Keycloak, OpenBao, Grafana, Jellyfin, Mealie, Home Assistant, ntfy and the Central Hub app, and backs up to the host's backup disk. The VPS app host sits outside the home.
svg.text: One Proxmox host at home, the c1 cluster and its apps, the agent box, and a rented server outside.
PROXMOX HOST: ONE MACHINE, AT HOME
